newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares end soft, bargain hunters expected.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares end soft, bargain hunters expected.

text.p: Zimbabwean industrial shares continued mixed on Thursday, but brokers said the market's current soft run may attract a wave of bargain hunters next week.
"So far its more or less in line with predictions -- mixed to soft. But there are indications that this trend is starting to attract investors looking for cheap pickings," one broker said.
"I think we are likely to get many of these next week," he added.

The Zimbabwe Stock Exchange's main industrial share index plunged 68.83 points to 10,512.92 on Thursday following losses in a number of key counters, including blue-chip banking group First Merchant Bank (FMB) FMB.ZI, which traded 300 cents down at 5,500.
But another banking group heavyweight, Barclays, gained 100 cents -- its second 100-cent rise in a row -- to 3,600.
In minings, coal miners Wankie also gained its second consecutive five cents to trade at 520, helping to lift the secondary seven-share mining index 2.53 points to to 959.64.
